mechanism: After the alignment, each mapped pair's node_sim is scaled by isolated_w when either endpoint has degree 0. isolated_w = MATCH_ISOLATED_NODE_WEIGHT when MATCH_EXCLUDE_ISOLATED_FROM_CORRESPONDENCE is False; when True, isolated_w = min(MATCH_ISOLATED_NODE_WEIGHT, MATCH_EXCLUDE_ISOLATED_FLOOR=0.5).
code_snippet: nodes=math.fsum(node_sim(u,v) * (isolated_w if (deg_a.get(u, 0) == 0 or deg_b.get(v, 0) == 0) else 1.0) for u,v in sorted(al.mapping.items()))

default_state.note: At the default flag state the multiplier is 1.0 for every pair, so the change is inert. It becomes active only when MATCH_EXCLUDE_ISOLATED_FROM_CORRESPONDENCE is True (the Task-3 winner cell), where isolated_w = min(1.0, 0.5) = 0.5 for pairs with an isolated endpoint.

winner_cell_state.note: All arms in this mission use the Task-3 winner cell, so isolated_w = 0.5 for isolated-endpoint pairs.
